title: Kaizen workflow runtime state
description: Active workflow state. Lives at <repo>/.workflow/state.json. Written by skills/workflow-routing/scripts/workflow.sh (init/advance/branch/artifact/dispatch).

prompt.description: The user's free-form prompt at init time.

routine.description: Hardcoded routine name (audit / build-feature / fix-bug / refactor / migrate / harden / batch-migrate / custom) OR 'schema:<name>' for schema-driven runs.

schema_name.description: v1.14.0+: the schema name if routine is 'schema:<name>'; empty for hardcoded routines.

stages.description: Ordered stage list. May be mutated by `branch` (v1.17.0+).

current.description: Index into .stages of the next-to-run stage. Bumped on advance.

artifacts.description: Ad-hoc {key: value} bag for stage outputs (plan_file, audit_report, etc.).

subagents.description: {agent_id: stage} mapping for SubagentStop hook auto-advance.

branch_decisions.description: v1.17.0+: audit trail of `workflow.sh branch <stage> <key>` calls.

new_tail.description: The stage list spliced into state.stages[current:].
